summary: Iteration 620: Comprehensive testing of Paket 2 (multi-page site builder) & Paket 3 (Google Hotel Ads, embed script, gift cards, exit-intent, deposit payment, cookie banner). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases passed. Frontend: public site (all blocks, nav, contact form, cookie banner), booking engine (gift-card purchase → Stripe checkout, landing URL auto-search, gift-redeem in details, wallet badges, summary logic), exit-intent popup with correct code, and admin distribution + site-builder panel all verified working. Site was left published on 'coastal' with all pages enabled and default block order per requirements.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — minor DOM structure warning, non-blocking

action_items: Fix minor React hydration warning on site page: an <option> element contains a <span> child (see language/currency selector likely).
critical_code_review_comments: site_builder.public_site: reviews aggregation uses $match on rating>=4 for list but $group total on all — inconsistency where 'rating.count' includes low-rating reviews but list only shows 4+ stars. Consider aligning or clarifying semantics.
be_distribution.exit_intent_save creates promo_codes with $setOnInsert but the id may be missing on updates for existing legacy promos; ensure id is always populated for downstream code paths.

payments.booking-checkout: deposit calculation only stores deposit_due/balance_due on master booking; other cart line bookings do not carry payment_plan flag which could confuse reservation-level views.
